# tplink_port_forward (Resource)

A port forwarding (virtual server) rule. Identified by its name, which is also the import ID. Renaming a rule replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tplink_port_forward" "web" {
  name          = "web"
  ip            = "192.168.0.4"
  external_port = "443"
  internal_port = "443"
  protocol      = "TCP"
  enabled       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_port` (String) WAN-side port (`443`) or range (`8000-9000`).
- `internal_port` (String) LAN-side port (single port).
- `ip` (String) Internal (LAN) IPv4 address to forward to.
- `name` (String) Rule name (unique on the router). Also the resource ID.
- `protocol` (String) TCP, UDP or ALL (case-insensitive).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (the rule name).
